_comment: S1-c budget cell. Pre-registered in PREREGISTRATION.md BEFORE running, and named as the discriminating follow-up inside the S1-b pre-registration before S1-b's result was known. Identical to experiments/sparse_s1 except steps 400 -> 1200. Tests whether the sparse advantage shrinks at longer budget (H-BUDGET) or persists (falsifying it). Seeds match the S1 rows so Delta(400) and Delta(1200) are measured on the same seeds.
